postTitle: Getting Ready For Freddy: Beginners Guide
postSubject: Some people are having trouble sussing out the game's mechanics. So I'm here to clear up the confusion and tell you how to survive the week.The goal of each night is to survive for six hours against a set of four deadly killer robots. You can use the security camera, the doors and the lights to protect yourself however they all take up energy. Using all of your energy leaves you wide open for attack, and is an (not so) instant game over.There are four robots.FREDDYFreddy is the wild card. He doesn't become really dangerous until night 5. Even so he can catch you out if you don't watch him. Freddy is camera shy, and will shut off the lights in any room he's inside/visited. You can spot him via his glowing eyes.Freddy is also a huge ♥♥♥♥, and will wait to scare the ♥♥♥♥ out of you when he gets inside. You can use this 30 second window to your advantage in a tight spot near the end of the night by using all of your energy and forcing him inside the booth, as he's the failure state for running out of energy. Play dead, don't move the mouse if you think he's inside with you.On later nights Freddy can and will ♥♥♥♥ you up. Don't hide behind the doors for too long or he'll grab your camping ♥♥♥. He'll become more aggressive and move more often, keep an ear out for his demonic laughter (which doesn't always trigger, so don't rely on it.)Unlike the other three, if Freddy is in the room you can still use the lights and doors.TL;DR: Keep the camera on him to stop him from moving.BONNIE AND CHICAThe dynamic duo of ''why the hell aren't the doors working?''. Early on they don't seem to be anything special, but as the week drags on you'll quickly realize these two always arrive together. They're active from the first night.They have the annoying ability to mess up the camera feed, which can be a pain when looking for Freddy. There isn't anything you can do about it though.They both stick to a different door respectively and can temporarily jam them, allowing the other to slip inside. Turn the lights on and shut the other door is the partner is there. If you can't close the doors or turn on the lights, too late.FOXYI see a lot of confusion surrounding the purpose of Foxy. Let me put it simply, she will sprint into your office when you least expect it, you will poo a little.You can activate it early by looking at the pirates cove on night 2, don't do this.Foxy doesn't become active intentionally until night 3, in which the camera begins on the pirates cove. This is as much help as you'll get from the game, keep your eye on those curtains. If you don't Foxy will come running and if you aren't fast enough at closing the doors it's game over. Foxy hitting the doors also drains a massive amount of power, so it's better to prevent it happening in the first place.Foxy only sprints if you look in the corridor, otherwise it's quite slow, so if it's absent from the cove resist the temptation and simply close the door.Foxy runs in a cycle. Every so often it'll run from the cove to the office like a cheetah. To prevent this the player can look at the cove via the camera feed, don't stare for too long though, this only makes it angry and speeds up the process. If you get caught flat footed it makes a loud banging noise as it runs for you.Yellow FreddyAlright I'll spill the beans. Yellow Freddy is extremely rare, but is most likely to be encountered on night 3. You may notice one of the rooms having a poster, with the yellow bear featured rather prominently, if you wish to avoid encountering him do not move away from the monitor while looking at this room, switch to another first.If you don't there's a small chance yellow Freddy will be in front of you. He will scream and the screen will become distorted. Quickly hopping back onto the camera is the only way to avoid death. If you don't he will either kill you, or potentially crash the game.Those are the basics. For those who want some spoilers...NIGHT 5Welcome to hell. Population: you. This is where the game really goes into overdrive, and where you need to make use of none of the skills you've learned so far. That's right, they act differently.Night 5 is simple, Freddy shifts into turbo mode and will readily shove his bear ♥♥♥♥ up you if you don't keep an eye on him. Bonnie and Chica gain the ability to jam the doors PERMANENTLY if they get too close, game over, restart. Foxy is active from the very beginning, so watch out.NIGHT 6: OVERTIMEDO NOT LOOK AT THE PIRATES COVE, IT WILL ACTIVATE FOXY, KEEP AN EYE ON FREDDY TO KEEP IT AWAY.Freddy becomes intense is this level. By far the biggest departure from the previous nights is that LOCKING THE DOORS WILL NOT PREVENT HIM FROM GETTING INSIDE. Keeping the camera on him is imperative, if you don't know where he is you may as well restart. You have to keep Freddy in place.Bonnie and Chica retain the ability to jam the doors for the entire night, making them both Freddy 2.0, keep in mind where both of them are.Upon beating the final night you unlock a special mode where you can toggle the difficulty of each robot. Secret codes can be inputted into this screen, 1987 being the most recent addition.It's nearly impossible to beat the game with every robot on 20. As Freddy will b-line it to your booth and get inside. If you manage to fight him off Foxy will make short work of you. But some brave souls have gotten close to 6AM.MISC STUFF''What's in the kitchen?'' - Nothing, stop wasting energy. Although they do make sounds when they're in there.
